method: GitHub code search (gh api search/code, up to 3 pages of 100) for each package of each provider with the query shape "<package>" filename:package.json path:/ (root package.json files naming the package); candidates in result order, one provider per repository; kept when not a fork or archived, pushed on or after 2025-10-21, under 60000 KB, not the provider's own organisation, and the root package.json at the default-branch HEAD declares the package; first 14 per provider.
